citations.quote: if the scm E is rotated by some O, then our estimation of C must be rotated in the same fashion
the large N limit allows one to actually compute the optimal ξ ’s from the data alone, without having to know C

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: A rotationally-invariant estimator keeps the sample covariance eigenvectors and only reshapes its eigenvalues; the oracle shrinkage ξ_k = v_kᵀ C v_k minimizing estimation error becomes computable from data alone in the large-dimension limit, per Potters & Bouchaud Ch.19.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Rotationally-Invariant Estimator (RIE) and the Oracle Shrinkage Function
